remarks: Welcome to 4804 Knight Crescent, an exclusive address and exceptional opportunity to build on nearly 1/4 acre (11,000+ sq. ft.) estate lot backing directly onto Edmonton’s river valley, with breathtaking west-facing sunset views from every level. Situated in the prestigious and nearly sold-out community of Keswick on the River, this remarkably rare property offers an extraordinary level of privacy, with only on neighbouring home and expansive river valley views surrounding the remaining sides, and rest assured not much development left around it to live through! The generous lot size creates an incredible canvas for both the home and an active and social outdoor lifestyle. With over 11,000 sq. ft. of land, there is tremendous opportunity to create a truly special family home that takes full advantage of the setting, views, privacy, and space. Photos shown are architectural concepts designed specifically for this lot to showcase some of the incredible possibilities this one-of-a-kind property has to offer. (id:67522)
